question: Ina code language, if KARAN is written as 45, then how will ARUN be written as in that language?
solution:
The pattern followed here is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f253014ba128b7ad77b3c8d4e4833e79dfb592948c26e5534f9e8d4973167aed.png] 

According to the alphabetical positions of the letters,

KARAN → K (11) + A (1) + R (18) + A (1) + N (14) = 11 + 1 + 18 + 1 + 14 = 45

Similarly,

ARUN → A (1) + R (18) + U (21) + N (14) = 1 + 18 + 21 + 14 = 54

Hence, ‘**54**’ is the correct answer.
